title: Concept: WebDAV write methods enabled in nginx — review required
description: In nginx, HTTP write verbs are enabled for a served location. WebDAV grants filesystem changes through ordinary HTTP requests, so the access-control decision moves from application code to a location block. A missing or misordered auth directive then exposes the directory to anyone who can reach it.
applicability: nginx servers that expose file shares or upload endpoints.
risk: Unauthenticated file write or deletion; MEDIUM severity.
